Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 1
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a factual error in the initial analysis by stating that World War I (First World War) had over 60 million casualties. Historical data indicates that World War I had approximately 20 million military deaths and 21 million wounded (total ~41 million), whereas World War II is the conflict associated with over 60 million casualties (estimates range from 70 to 85 million total). This incorrect premise led the Planner to incorrectly prioritize World War I and subsequently misinterpret the search results which correctly identified the memorial as commemorating both wars, but the final conclusion was skewed by the false casualty statistic.
